title: Simple and Everything levels, new Edit alarm and ring screen
note: PR #51 open for Thursday's build, stacked on PR #50; Curió merges after testing on the phone.
details: A Simple or Everything switch at the top of Settings. New installs get one first-run question (Simple ticked); existing installs stay on Everything and never see it. Simple keeps alarms and the basics; Everything is today's app with the header icons as labelled pills and Settings in five folded groups. Edit alarm gets Ring or music, Rings for and Gentle wake, each with a small menu and Use for new alarms, plus a When this rings, I will… line. The ring screen shows that line, a smaller quote and the hint line only for the first three rings; the round countdown clock stays. Nothing about how alarms are scheduled or ring changed. New text in 20 languages is machine-written and needs native review.
